summary: PARTIAL — blocked at mcp_tool_discovery_in_session (Stage 7 of ~16). The full path ChatGPT controller → Git request → Claude operator → rhino-cad MCP → rhinocode/Rhino → validation/artifacts → Git report was NOT demonstrated end to end. First failing stage: rhino-cad tools not available in Claude session. Root cause: project-scoped .mcp.json is only injected into sessions started from (or below) the project root directory. This session started from /Users/nes; rhino-cad was absent from the session's active server list despite claude mcp get reporting Connected. Improvements vs Phase 12: orientation skill now works correctly, server import fixed, .mcp.json registered. New fix required: add rhino-cad to global user MCP config (~5 min).

blockers.title: Project .mcp.json tools not in session when Claude started outside project root

notes_for_controller: The work commit is 497a556f9403c6d37f8b145d3efa0485e07efc4d; this report is the receipt commit.
Phase 12 blockers (server import, registration) are all fixed and confirmed. This is a new, distinct blocker at a different layer.
The fix is one command: claude mcp add --scope user. This adds rhino-cad to ~/.claude.json so it loads in every session regardless of starting directory.
Alternatively, the operator can start Claude Code from /Users/nes/bin/mcp/rhino-cad-mcp directly. Global registration is cleaner.
No orientation, runtime, installer, or bridge protocol files were modified.
